note: Wall/ceiling dressing by helper f77ac026. Godot axes: the wall is the plane z = 0 and the model sits on its +Z side (Blender -Y); ceiling items hang down -Y from y = 0. Each model has its own 1024 texture set (albedo + normal + 512 ORM) with a normal map, so Props.detail() leaves the materials alone. No collision needed (thin wall dressing) except maybe fire_ext_cabinet.

models.mount_point: Origin = on the wall surface at the START of the run, on the bundle's centre line. Runs along +X for 4.0 m and sits in front of the wall (+Z). Ends are cut flush, so runs can be chained every 4 m. Mount at about 2.6-3.2 m height.

Origin = on the ceiling surface, midway between the two hooks (hooks at x = -1.5 and +1.5). Cables hang down to about 0.8 m below the ceiling (-Y). Cable ends rise back into the ceiling at x = +/-1.85.

Origin = on the wall surface at the START of the run, at the height of the pipe group's centre. Runs along +X for 4.0 m, 0.21 m deep (+Z). Three pipes (coolant green with a red gate valve at x = 2.7, N2 yellow, O2 aluminium-clad) on strut-channel brackets at x = 0.5 / 2.0 / 3.5; flanged joints at 1.4 and 3.2. Chain every 4 m.
Origin = on the wall surface at the centre of the vent. 0.8 x 0.5 m, protrudes 0.105 m (+Z); dark duct interior with a fan behind angled louvres.

Origin = on the wall surface at the centre of the panel. 1.0 x 1.2 m, protrudes 0.035 m. Hazard-striped frame, screwed inset panel, two grab handles, quarter-turn latch and a DANGER HIGH VOLTAGE label.

Origin = on the wall surface at the BOTTOM centre of the cabinet (mount the origin ~1.0 m above the floor). 0.43 w x 0.72 h x 0.25 d m; red cabinet with a glass door (material GlassCabinet) and a CO2 extinguisher inside. Put sign_fire_extinguisher decal above it.
